text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seiun Sky participated in a mock 
race. How did it turn out...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Sei-chan went and pulled off an 
incredible win, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though. Truth be told, I wasn't 
really planning on winning today, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to play it off like I 
wasn't in top form yet, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see~. For some reason, my legs 
feel strangely light."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just running along thinking 'Huh? 
Huh?', and before I knew it, I took 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It seems some Trainer out there has 
quietly and thoroughly built up her core 
strength~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Cheers to our great trainer, great coach, 
great mentor, great teacher, and great 
master!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And so. I worked hard in the race, so is 
it okay if we wrap up practice for today?
choice_data_list:
...You look like you've still got plenty 
in the tank, so just a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. So if they grow too much, this kind 
of thing can happen too, huh...
